thread.title: Matulonis advances to 400m hurdles quarterfinals at NCAA East prelims
thread.title_full: Matulonis advances to 400m hurdles quarterfinals at NCAA East prelims

author: Keystone Today
title: Matulonis advances to 400m hurdles quarterfinals at NCAA East prelims
text:
The University of Pennsylvania men’s track and field team completed day one of competition at the NCAA East First Round at the University of Kentucky’s Outdoor Track & Field Complex, according to a May 27 announcement.
Junior Ryan Matulonis advanced to the 400-meter hurdles quarterfinals after finishing first in his heat with a time of 49.46 seconds. The quarterfinal round for the 400-meter hurdles is scheduled for Friday at 7:25 p.m.
Other Penn athletes competing included Alex Sadikov, who finished 34th in the 400-meter hurdles with a time of 51.39 seconds; Tiago Socarras, who placed 38th in the first round of the 800 meters with a time of 1:48.82; and Vinay Raman, who was 44th in the same event with a time of 1:49.70.
In additional events, Nayyir Newash-Campbell finished 31st in the first round of the men’s 400 meters with a time of 46.16 seconds. Thomas Bucks tied for 33rd place in pole vault by clearing a height of 5.05 meters (16 feet, 6.75 inches). Atticus Soehren finished in twenty-ninth place in javelin with a throw measuring 63.44 meters (208 feet, two inches).
Live coverage and results are available on ESPN+.
